title: How Much Do $\ell_1$ Attacks Need Concentrated Perturbations?
abstract: arXiv:2610.27773v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A global $\ell_1$ budget limits how much an adversary may change an image, not how that change is distributed. We ask how much of an $\ell_1$ attack's observed success remains when large coordinate changes are restricted. We add a per-coordinate cap to the budget, enforce the joint constraint by exact in-loop projection, and sweep the cap for APGD-$\ell_1$, SLIDE, and FMN-$\ell_1$ without altering their objectives. Across 18 standard-model settings, caps of at most $32/255$ retain a median $97\%$ of attack success relative to each method's native uncapped baseline, while median peak magnitude falls by $80\%$ and median effective support nearly triples. At matched realized $\ell_1$, capped perturbations remain structurally distinct; separate ImageNet comparisons also show lower LPIPS and DISTS at selected caps. Direct in-loop constrained optimization preserves up to $88$ percentage points more attack success than post-hoc clipping, high

translated_title: ℓ₁攻击需要多大程度的集中扰动？
translated_abstract: 全局ℓ₁预算限制的是攻击者可以改变图像的程度，而非这种改变如何分布。我们探究当限制大幅度的单坐标变化时，ℓ₁攻击所观察到的成功还能保留多少。我们在预算中加入了每个坐标的上限约束，通过精确的循环内投影来强制执行联合约束，并在不改变其优化目标的情况下对APGD-ℓ₁、SLIDE和FMN-ℓ₁这三种方法扫描该上限。在18个标准模型设置中，不超过32/255的上限相对于各方法原本无上限的基线保留了中位数97%的攻击成功率，同时扰动峰值幅度的中位数下降了80%，有效支持范围的中位数几乎增至三倍。在匹配的实际ℓ₁范数下，受上限约束的扰动在结构上依然与众不同；单独的ImageNet比较也显示，在选定的上限下LPIPS和DISTS感知距离更低。直接的循环内约束优化比事后裁剪能多保留高达88个百分点的攻击成功率。
tldr: 研究发现即使对每个坐标施加扰动上限以抑制集中扰动，ℓ₁对抗攻击仍能保留约97%的攻击成功率，表明其成功并不依赖高度集中的大幅扰动。
